'''''Sinabawang gulay''''', usually anglicized as '''Filipino vegetable soup''', is a [[Filipino cuisine|Filipino]] [[vegetable soup]] made with [[leafy vegetables]] (usually  [[Moringa oleifera|moringa]] leaves) and various other vegetables in a broth seasoned with seafood [[Stock (food)|stock]] or ''[[patis (sauce)|patis]]'' (fish sauce).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pinoyrecipe.net/laswa-recipe/|title=Authentic Laswa Recipe|access-date=August 15, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.experiencenegros.com/ilonggo-food-laswa-recipe/|title=Ilonggo Food: Laswa Recipe|date=May 14, 2013 |access-date=December 18, 2017}}</ref> The ingredients of the dish can vary widely. It is eaten on its own or over white rice.<ref name="mgr">{{cite web |title=Sinabawang Gulay (Utan Bisaya) |url=https://www.mamasguiderecipes.com/tag/sinabawang-gulay/ |website=Mama's Guide Recipes |access-date=April 20, 2019}}</ref>
